title: Acceleration magnitude of B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the deceleration magnitude of train B using the given stopping distance and initial speed.

title: Collision time determination
description: Essential: Correctly determines if a collision occurs and, if so, calculates the correct time after braking.

title: Minimum acceleration of A
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the minimum acceleration required for train A to avoid a collision.

title: Relative motion analysis
description: Important: Applies kinematic equations to both trains to analyze their relative positions over time.

title: Equal speed condition
description: Important: Recognizes and uses the condition that the trains reach a common speed to find the minimum required acceleration for A.

title: Quadratic equation solving
description: Optional: Correctly sets up and solves the quadratic equation for the collision time in part (2).

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Uses acceleration with an incorrect sign (positive instead of negative) in kinematic equations for train B.

title: Ignoring initial separation
description: Pitfall: Fails to account for the initial 500m separation when setting up equations for displacement or collision.
